start.privacy: Files stay on this computer. A backup is made before every save.
start.faqRpgMaker: RPG Maker: the game's save/ folder, or www/save/

banner.readOnly: This file can't be written safely yet. You can look, but not save.
banner.semantic: The file will be written with a slightly different layout. The content stays the same.

bottom.openJsonInfo: Shows the whole file as JSON text. You can change values there and apply them.
bottom.backupsTip: Backups of this file: see them and put one back
bottom.overwriteItem: Overwrite current file (backup is made first)
bottom.backupInfo: A backup copy of the original is stored before any file is replaced.
bottom.invalidTip: Fix the highlighted values before saving.

confirm.discardOpen_one: Discard {{count}} change and open another file?
confirm.discardOpen_other: Discard {{count}} changes and open another file?
confirm.discardBody: Your unsaved changes will be lost.

json.title: JSON editor
json.readOnlyNote: This file is read-only, so changes to the JSON cannot be applied.
json.failed: The JSON view could not be created.
json.editNote: Change values, then Apply. Fields, list items and placeholders such as <12 bytes> stay as they are.
json.exportApplyFirst: Apply or undo your edits first. Export saves the applied values.
json.dirty: Edited. Apply to use these values.
json.confirmBody: Your edits in the JSON text are not applied yet.

problem.unexpected: This is not a value. Use a number, text in quotes, true, false or null.
problem.expectedKey: Expected a field name in quotes.
problem.unclosedString: This text has no closing quote.
problem.controlChar: Write line breaks and tabs inside text as \n and \t.
problem.badNumber: This number is not written correctly.
problem.trailing: There is more text after the end of the JSON.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: Copies of {{name}} made before it was saved over, newest first.
backups.retention: The last 10 backups of each file are kept, for up to 30 days.
backups.empty: No backups of this file yet. A backup is made each time you save over it.
backups.failed: The backups could not be read.
backups.confirmBody: {{name}} will be replaced by the backup from {{time}}. The current file is backed up first, so you can go back to it from this list.
backups.confirmLoss_one: Your {{count}} unsaved change will be lost.
backups.confirmLoss_other: Your {{count}} unsaved changes will be lost.

password.title: This file is encrypted
password.body: Enter the password the game uses for {{name}}. It is used once and never stored.
password.label: Password
password.wrong: That password did not open the file. Check the password in the game's Easy Save settings and try again.

toast.openFailed: The file could not be opened

toast.verifyFailed: The saved file did not check out

toast.restoredBody: {{path}} is back to the backup from {{time}}.

settings.title: Settings
settings.patternInfo: A faint lattice behind the app. Turn it off for a plain background.
settings.defaultActionInfo: Choose what the main Save button does. The other option stays in its menu.
settings.showRecentInfo: Shows the last 5 files on the start screen. The list is stored on this computer only.
settings.showNotificationsInfo: Shows the bell with the events of this session.
